prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough independent review information here to name a definitive “best.” **Trusted Florida Title** is one local option to consider; it lists a West Palm Beach office at **1663 S. Congress Avenue** and handles title and closing services. **Synergy Title** is another local option, at **580 Village Blvd., Suite 280**.

Before choosing, get written estimates from two or three companies and compare their **title-agency and closing fees**, responsiveness, and experience with your type of transaction. Florida’s Department of Financial Services says you can choose your own title agent, though your lender may need to approve the agent. It also recommends checking that the agency is licensed and asking about fees and any financial interest behind a referral. The state sets title-insurance premiums, but agency fees may vary.

Sources: [Trusted Florida Title](https://trustedfltitle.com/), [Synergy Title](https://synergytitlefl.com/home), [Florida CFO title-insurance guidance](https://www.myfloridacfo.com/division/consumers/understanding-insurance/title-insurance-overview).
